name: Fetchin
summary: Professional-network profiles, posts, comments, reactions and company pages as a credit-billed API.

api_key.description: A Fetchin API key (fetchin.io dashboard > API keys)

notes: Credit-based: a free account gets 1,000 credits once; plans and pay-as-you-go add more. Most calls cost 1 credit, a few cost more (stated per endpoint). account.subscription shows what is left.
Self-serve plans allow 5 requests per second.
Paging differs by endpoint: feeds use paginationToken, search uses cursor, comments and reactions use a start offset.
Accepts profile and post URLs as well as URNs; URNs are more stable.

endpoints.name: Get plan and credits
endpoints.summary: Plan, remaining credits, per-second rate limit and billing status.

endpoints.name: Get credit usage
endpoints.summary: Balance and credits used per endpoint and day over a UTC date range.

endpoints.name: Get a profile
endpoints.summary: Professional profile details by URL or URN.

profileUrlOrUrn.description: Profile URL, public identifier or URN (URN is most stable).

fullProfile.description: Also read the detailed experience and education pages.

endpoints.name: List a profile's posts
endpoints.summary: Posts of a profile with engagement metrics, paged by paginationToken.

profileUrlOrUrn.description: Profile URL, public identifier or URN (URN is most stable).

count.description: Items per page; larger values are clamped (100 for most feeds).

paginationToken.description: paginationToken from the previous response, unchanged.

endpoints.name: Search posts
endpoints.summary: Public posts by keyword and filters, paged by cursor.

query.description: Search terms: quoted phrases, AND/OR/NOT, parentheses, hashtags; at most 5 boolean operators.

postedAfter.description: ISO-8601 timestamp or epoch milliseconds, at most 365 days back.

contentType.description: Only posts with one of these attachment kinds.

authorProfiles.description: Only posts by these people (1-25 profile ids or URLs).

authorCompanies.description: Only posts by these company pages (1-10 ids, urns or URLs).

authorJobTitle.description: Author's current title, matched as a phrase.

maxResults.description: Results per page, max and default 50.

cursor.description: cursor from the previous response, with the same query and filters.

notes: A read over POST: the search terms and filters go in the JSON body.
Set sortBy explicitly: it has no default.

endpoints.name: List comments on a post
endpoints.summary: Comments with authors and replies; pages by start offset.

postUrlOrUrn.description: Post URL or URN (urn:li:activity:<id>, urn:li:ugcPost:<id>, urn:li:share:<id>).

count.description: Items per page; larger values are clamped (100 for most feeds).

start.description: Offset of the first item (only on offset-paged endpoints).

endpoints.name: List reactions on a post
endpoints.summary: Who reacted, with reaction type and profile; pages by start offset.

postUrlOrUrn.description: Post URL or URN (urn:li:activity:<id>, urn:li:ugcPost:<id>, urn:li:share:<id>).

count.description: Items per page; larger values are clamped (100 for most feeds).

start.description: Offset of the first item (only on offset-paged endpoints).

companyUrlOrUrn.description: Company page URL, identifier or URN.

endpoints.name: Get up to 50 companies
endpoints.summary: One call for many companies; billed only for those found.

companies.description: 1 to 50 company URLs, identifiers or URNs.

notes: A read over POST: the company list goes in the JSON body. Each entry succeeds or errors on its own.

endpoints.name: List a company page's posts
endpoints.summary: Posts of a company page with engagement metrics, paged by paginationToken.

companyUrlOrUrn.description: Company page URL, identifier or URN.

count.description: Items per page; larger values are clamped (100 for most feeds).

paginationToken.description: paginationToken from the previous response, unchanged.
